title: Build the remote-proxy persisted change view without cloning the session transcript
outcome: The before/after change views that decide whether a mirrored proxy is stamped no longer clone record.session's message list (its Arc message pointers) on every broad snapshot; the stamp decisions are unchanged.
acceptance: RemoteProxyChangeView's persisted component is built without cloning the session's messages, for example by projecting the persisted record without the transcript, and is still compared byte for byte as before.
The existing remote_sync_noop_stamp tests, all seven positive controls included, pass unchanged on the new code.
